sections.heading: Guessing about the past
sections.body:
Just as the future guesses about the present, the **conditional** guesses about the **past**:

- *¿Qué hora sería cuando llegaste?* — What time was it (roughly) when you arrived?
- *Serían las once.* — It must have been about eleven.
- *¿Por qué no vino Ana? — Estaría enferma.* — She was probably sick.
- *Tendría unos veinte años cuando se casó.* — She must have been about twenty when she got married.

sections.heading: The future in the past
sections.body: When you report what someone said about the future, the future becomes conditional: *Dice que vendrá* (He says he'll come) → *Dijo que vendría* (He said he would come). *Pensé que llovería.* (I thought it would rain.) You'll use this a lot in reported speech.

sections.heading: Hypotheses
sections.body: The conditional describes what **would** happen in an imagined situation: *¿Qué harías en mi lugar?* (What would you do in my place?) *Yo no diría nada.* (I wouldn't say anything.) *Con más dinero, compraría una casa.* In B1.15 you'll combine it with *si* ("if") clauses.

sections.heading: Irregular stems (same as the future)
sections.body: *tendría, pondría, saldría, vendría, podría, sabría, querría, haría, diría, habría.* And *habría* is the conditional of *hay*: *Habría unas cien personas.* (There must have been about a hundred people.)

vocab: there must have been / there would be
examples: ¿Qué hora sería cuando llegaste?
What time was it when you arrived?
Serían las once.
It must have been about eleven.
¿Por qué no vino Ana? Estaría enferma.
Why didn't Ana come? She was probably sick.
Tendría unos veinte años cuando se casó.
She must have been about twenty when she got married.
Habría unas cien personas en la fiesta.
There must have been about a hundred people at the party.
Dijo que vendría.
He said he would come.
Pensé que llovería.
I thought it would rain.
Me prometió que me llamaría.
She promised me she would call me.
¿Qué harías en mi lugar?
What would you do in my place?
Yo no diría nada.
I wouldn't say anything.
Con más dinero, compraría una casa.
With more money, I'd buy a house.
Sabía que saldrías tarde.
I knew you would leave late.
Dijeron que pondrían la mesa.
They said they would set the table.
¿Querrías venir con nosotros?
Would you like to come with us?
No sabría qué hacer.
I wouldn't know what to do.
Estarían cansados después del viaje.
They must have been tired after the trip.
Pensábamos que sería fácil.
We thought it would be easy.
